lines.en: label chikasummer2nightgen:
scene chikasummer2nightgen
if yumiblock == False:
I make my way over to Chika’s apartment to spend the night with her while Yumi and Chinami sit in the living room reading manga together.

Neither of them pay any attention to me (Likely because a certain someone asked them not to), so I’m free to spend a wholesome night out on the balcony with my fake girlfriend while she longingly gazes up at the sky.
else:
I make my way over to Chika’s apartment to spend the night with her while Chinami sits in the living room watching TV.
lines.zh: 我前往 Chika 的公寓陪她过夜，Chinami 坐在客厅里看电视。

lines.en: She doesn't pay any attention to us, so I'm free to spend a wholesome night out on the balcony with my fake girlfriend while she longingly gazes up at the sky.
lines.zh: 她没注意我们，于是我可以跟我的假女朋友在阳台上度过一个清清白白的夜晚，她则怅然地仰望天空。

lines.en: It feels a little odd spending time together when I know that we’re being secretly spectated at all times, but I guess that sort of family dynamic is exactly what Chika wants in the first place.
lines.zh: 明知我们时刻都在被偷偷旁观，相处起来还是有点怪，不过我想这种家庭氛围本来就是 Chika 想要的。

lines.en: She’s not the type to mind the ones close to her knowing her feelings.
lines.zh: 她不是那种会在意亲近的人知道自己心事的人。

lines.en: She’s the exact opposite of me.
But as long as she keeps those feelings away from everyone else...I think that’s okay.
lines.zh: 但只要她把那些感情对其他人藏好……我觉得那就没问题。

lines.en: scene black
We don’t need to be the same to want each other. We can just...do it.
lines.zh: 我们不需要一样才能渴望彼此。我们可以就……去做。

lines.en: And if and when things self-destruct, less people will get caught in the blast.
lines.zh: 而且如果、当事情自我毁灭的时候，被卷进爆炸的人会少一些。

lines.en: We’ll crawl away with some skin still left on our bones and pick ourselves up as if nothing ever happened.
lines.zh: 我们会带着骨头上的一点皮爬走，然后若无其事地重新站起来。

lines.en: But for now, we’ll remain like this- two bodies on a balcony under a sky full of stars.
lines.zh: 但现在，我们就保持这样——满天繁星下，阳台上的两具身体。

lines.en: We head back inside and I leave when they all fall asleep.
lines.zh: 我们回到屋里，等她们都睡着了我就离开了。

Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
lines.zh: Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！
